description: This file defines an enumeration 'JournalEntryType' used to specify whether a journal entry is a debit or credit within the accounting domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: JournalEntryType
classes.description: An enum representing the type of journal entry, either CREDIT or DEBIT, with associated utility methods for conversion and identification.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the journal entry type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the journal entry type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding JournalEntryType enum value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the enum constant.

methods.name: isDebitType
methods.description: Checks if the current type is DEBIT.

methods.name: isCreditType
methods.description: Checks if the current type is CREDIT.
